keyPoints: Sarvangsam (congruent) aakaar har tarah se barabar hote hain — ek ko utha kar doosre par poora rakh sakte ho, koi hissa bahar nahi niklega — naap me poori barabari.
SSS: teenon bhujaen barabar to tribhuj sarvangsam; SAS: do bhujaen aur beech ka kon barabar to sarvangsam — ye do sabse zyada istemal hote hain.
ASA: do kon aur beech ki bhuja barabar to sarvangsam; AAS (do kon aur gair-shamil bhuja) bhi kaam karta hai.
RHS: samkon tribhuj me karn aur ek bhuja barabar to sarvangsam — sirf samkon tribhujon ke liye.
Samadvibahu tribhuj me barabar bhujaon ke saamne ke kon barabar hote hain — aur iska vilom bhi satya hai: barabar konon ke saamne ki bhujaen barabar.
Sarvangsamta se bhuja-kon milte hain (CPCT) — pehle siddh karo tribhuj sarvangsam, phir bache hisse barabar likho.
Aam galti: SSA se sarvangsamta maan lena — do bhujaen aur gair-shamil kon ka barabar hona kaafi nahi hai.
subject: Maths
title: Tribhuj: Sarvangsamta
